row.name: flutter_sharez
row.description: 🚀 Flutter Sharez is a modern file-sharing app built using the Flutter framework and powered by Riverpod. This app allows users to effortlessly share and receive files across different platforms. With an intuitive and user-friendly interface, Flutter Sharez redefines the way you share files.
